summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of mib-gold XAUUSD trading system. 18/18 backend pytest cases pass (status, config, chart TFs, analysis with 10 engines, news gate, manual news blocking, Claude AI news interpret, auto-trade toggle, trades CRUD/filters/stats, full backtest flow with attribution+trades+bars+list, WebSocket snapshot+tick stream). Frontend Terminal, Journal, and Backtest Lab screens all render correctly with all required data-testids present and populated. WebSocket live feed working (metrics updating, session/price/consensus). Auto-trade toggle switches ON<->PAUSED. Backtest 5d completed in ~40s with 1 trade, 10-engine attribution table rendered, equity curve visible, scrubber interactive.
critical_code_review_comments: Initial test_analysis assertion expected 'consensus' key at top level; actual payload uses 'entry' (top-down entry consensus) plus top-level 'votes'. Test was updated to match the real contract. Consider aligning naming or documenting the payload contract to avoid confusion.
server.py contains all 20+ routes in a single file (~334 lines). Still manageable but nearing the threshold for splitting into routers by feature (status/news/backtest/trades).
seed_data_creation: Manual news event 'TEST_manual_event' posted at sim_time+5m during test_news_manual_blocks; ephemeral (in-memory gate). Backtests persisted to Mongo (backtests, trades collections).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py; run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_backend_api.py -v`. Analysis API top-level keys are: time, session, bias, structure, struct_ok, timeframes, entry, votes, summary, fire, gate_reason, advisory, executed. Frontend uses lightweight-charts (no locale error observed). SIM speed is 60x - M5 bar every ~5s real. Backtest of 5d ~35s. Manual news event triggers gate immediately. AI news interpret (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent) works and returns model 'claude-sonnet-4-6'.
